Nashville Riverboats gave us a wonderful experience. Their hospitality was amazing, and everyone was so helpful and friendly. We had a great dinner cruise with beautiful views of downtown Nashville and a sunset over the river. Sitting on a porch swing watching the sun set with my fiance is an instant treasured memory.

We were actually touring the riverboat as a wedding venue, and the staff was so helpful and kind to us throughout the process. It was the first place we toured where we really loved the energy. It was the first place where we felt truly valued, like they felt lucky to have us, not like they thought we would be lucky to have them. These are down-to-earth, empathetic people. We worked directly with Kelsie Hamilton who answered all of our questions and was so courteous and helpful with us.
